summary:
Plan of w202 (spec-integration#r44) in plan.md.
Red today: spec-integration.feature is unbound; nothing reads an upstream from spec/index.md; the integrate brief, agent and skill give a change list only.
Decisions: spec/index.md names upstreams in a body section `## Upstreams` (id plus path to its published spec; not frontmatter, per references-are-ids); the round gives `requests` (one entry per upstream: id and EARS lines) beside `changes`; work run puts the absolute spec path in the Read list and the request form in the integrate brief only when an upstream is named.
supervise_rounds.py dropped from the set: reading/raising the lines is supervision#r135; the result.json is already kept with the stage directory.
docs/capability-format.md added to document the index section.
Scenario bound through the stand-in session, Thens asserting the brief (upstream, spec path, form) and the kept draft and result.
No existing test breaks: with no upstream the brief is unchanged.
Open cases: missing spec path, several upstreams, pinned version, tie to a capability (r136), permissions.
